game.title: Fire in the Village.
tip.1: Never light bonfires on windy days.
tip.2: Never throw matches on the ground.
tip.3: If you see a fire, call 112.

guide.about.title: - About -
guide.about.p1: "Fire in the Village" is an interactive narrative developed by CEABN (Centre for Applied Ecology "Prof. Baeta Neves") at Instituto Superior de Agronomia, for the education platform
guide.about.p2: In collaboration with Colab ForestWise and Civil Protection.
credits.2: Artistic and multimedia direction: Letícia Oliveira;
credits.3: UX/UI design and programming: Letícia Oliveira;
guide.how.title: - How to play -
guide.how.intro: Read each situation carefully and choose one of the options to move the story forward. Your decisions have consequences and, in the end, you find out whether you made the best choices for dealing with a wildfire.
guide.how.interactive.d: not everything is solved with the choice buttons. In some scenes you interact directly with the screen, for example by dialling a number on the phone or ticking answers in a quiz notebook. When a scene requires it, tap those elements to continue.
guide.how.timer.d: at certain moments a timer appears in the corner of the screen. In an emergency, every second counts. The time can be extended or turned off in Settings.
guide.how.fast.d: tapping the text box (or pressing Space) shows it immediately.
guide.how.sound.d: the icon in the top left corner turns the sound on or off.
guide.how.settings.d: in the top right corner you can adjust the volume, the font size, full screen and animations. You can also go back or restart the scenario.
restart.title: Restart scenario?
restart.warning: This action cannot be undone and will erase all your progress so far.
